ModMetaData.name: Practical Upgrades
ModMetaData.author: lyj
ModMetaData.description:
Adds three sequential upgrade levels to the vanilla tool cabinet and, when Odyssey is active, the grav engine. Grav engine upgrades progressively restore vanilla facility limits while adding built-in power generation and rechargeable grav energy that offsets launch fuel.
为原版工具柜加入三级顺序强化；启用 Odyssey 时，也为逆重引擎加入升级路线。引擎升级会逐步恢复原版设施上限，并提供内置发电及可抵消起飞燃料的充能式逆重能量。
